# Nisha Fashions Wear

> Bangladesh Apparel Manufacturer, Supplier and Garment Sourcing Partner.

Nisha Fashions Wear (NFW) is a premier apparel production management and garment sourcing company based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. With over 20 years of textile and garment business experience, the company manages ethical, high-quality production across Knitwear, Woven, Denim, and Sweaters for international fashion brands, wholesale importers, and department stores across Europe, the United States, and Canada.

## Core Capabilities & Divisions
- [Knitwear](/categories/knit): High-volume t-shirts, combed cotton pique polos, heavy fleece hoodies (300-420 GSM), joggers, loopback French terry, activewear.
- [Woven](/categories/woven): Tailored formal and casual shirts, chinos, cargo utility trousers, poplin blouses, lightweight outerwear.
- [Denim](/categories/denim): 5-pocket jeans, trucker jackets, sustainable Jeanologia laser whiskering, ozone eco-bleach, rigid and high-stretch denim.
- [Sweaters](/categories/sweater): Computerised flat-knit (3GG to 14GG) Shima Seiki and Stoll machinery, cable-knit pullovers, fine-gauge merino blends, cardigans.
- [Various & Workwear](/categories/various-items): 6-panel chino caps, cushion athletic socks, canvas tote bags, hospitality aprons, infant wear.

## Operational Standards & Disciplines
- Full-service scope: Factory allocation, pattern CAD 2D/3D grading, fabric lab dips & strike-offs, open-book FOB costing, weekly TNA critical path tracking, on-site inline and AQL 2.5 final quality audits, export customs logistics.
- Compliance: Certified partner units under WRAP, BSCI, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, SEDEX/SMETA, GOTS, and Accord / RSC Building and Fire Safety.
